title: Pericoronary radiomics signature from machine learning associates with functional ischemia
summary: A retrospective two-center study of 350 patients with coronary CT angiography (training 134, validation 66, testing 150 with invasive angiography) extracted 1,691 radiomic features from pericoronary tissue. Boruta with random forest selected the top 8 features to form a Rad-signature for CT-FFR of 0.8 or less, with AUCs 0.83, 0.82 and 0.82 (training, validation, testing) versus 0.55, 0.55 and 0.52 for fat attenuation index; the combined model reached 0.86, 0.85 and 0.83. Another 45 patients with invasive FFR were included to check performance. The reference for training was CT-FFR rather than invasive FFR.
